notes: Read all three units, territorial context, all twenty candidates and the review. Preserved evaluative typing for federal responsibility and school and crime assessments, standardized the model-city and economic metaphors, restored D.C. scope to school choice, classified civic resurgence as an assessment of past contribution, named the U.S. Armed Forces, and expressed the charity and productive-capacity characterizations without decorative metaphors.

claims.claim_text: The platform characterizes Washington, D.C. as a special responsibility of the U.S. federal government.
It characterizes some schools near the Education Department as among the country's worst performing.
It characterizes some neighborhoods near the Justice Department as among the country's most crime-ridden.
Washington, D.C. should be improved into an exemplary city.
A D.C. school-choice initiative characterized as landmark was a major Republican initiative.
The D.C. first-time-homebuyer credit and school-choice initiative are assessed as having contributed to civic renewal.
Republicans honor D.C. residents currently serving honorably in the U.S. Armed Forces.
Republicans honor D.C. residents who previously served in the U.S. Armed Forces.
The U.S. free-market economy is characterized as a major source of charitable capacity.
The U.S. free-market economy is said to release productive capacity beyond what other societies can achieve.
